zh: 嗯。
t: Mm.

zh: 可以。
t: Okay.
…Mm.

zh: 嗯？
t: Hmm?

zh: 对。
t: Right.

zh: ……嘿嘿。
t: …Heh.

zh: // 如果有人读到这里，请替我回答一次。
t: // If anyone reads this far, please answer once for me.

zh: 转化方式：改写。执行。
t: Mode of transformation: rewrite. Execute.

zh: 空气里有青草和旧书页混在一起的味道。
t: The air carried the smell of fresh grass and old book pages, all mixed together.

zh: 五个人的平衡里，不允许第六个秘密。
t: Within the balance of the five, no sixth secret is allowed.

zh: 不会太久的。
t: It won't be long.

zh: ……什么？
t: …What?

zh: 你说爱没有形状。
t: You said love has no shape.

zh: 好。
t: All right.

zh: 棱。
t: Prism.

zh: 这样很好。
t: This is good.

zh: 可我还是想亲耳听一遍。
t: But I still want to hear it with my own ears.

zh: （她把能算的都算尽了，最后只剩这一句要亲耳听。）
t: (She had calculated everything there was to calculate; in the end, only this one line remained for her to hear with her own ears.)
…Ha.

zh: 平行分支
t: Parallel branches

zh: 「这些日子，全是我替他们过的。」
t: "All these days, I lived them on their behalf."

zh: 零想了很久。
t: Zero thought for a long while.

zh: 我本来就没有形状。
t: I never had a shape to begin with.

zh: （这孩子。说得比我还漂亮。）
t: (This child. Speaks more beautifully than I do.)

zh: 能。
t: Yes.

zh: 产物：待命名。
t: Product: yet to be named.

zh: 光的结晶
t: The Crystal of Light

zh: THE CRYSTAL
t: THE CRYSTAL

zh: 声学特征：三角波 / 锯齿波 / 正弦波。
t: Acoustic features: triangle wave / sawtooth wave / sine wave.

zh: 几何特征：三角 / 四边 / 五边 / 菱形。
t: Geometric features: triangle / quadrilateral / pentagon / rhombus.

zh: 晚安。做一场五颜六色的、发光的梦哦。
t: Good night. Have a dream—colorful, and glowing.

zh: 喂——听得见吗？听得见就点一下。
t: Hey—can you hear me? If you can, give a tap.

zh: 好，那我开始讲了。反正你迟早会来，早讲晚讲都一样。
t: All right, then I'll begin. You'll come eventually anyway; sooner or later makes no difference.

zh: 先自报家门。我叫引渡者。从未来尽头往回走的那一种，纯粹之爱与狂欢的那一种。
t: First, let me introduce myself. I am the Ferryman. The kind who walks back from the end of the future—the kind of pure love and revelry.

zh: 职称听着唬人，干的活其实很朴素：替那些已经不在的家伙，把故事送到你手里。
t: The title sounds grand, but the work is plain enough: I carry the stories of those who are no longer here, and deliver them into your hands.

zh: 眼前这一整片，是世界的里子。
t: This whole expanse before you is the lining of the world.

zh: 外面那个世界靠事件往前走。里头这一片，靠记账。
t: The world outside moves forward by events. This inner place moves by keeping accounts.

zh: 对，记账。五个家伙，五本账，各记各的。
t: Right—keeping accounts. Five of them, five ledgers, each keeping their own.

zh: 他们各自认定一样东西「算存在过」，然后把它一条一条写下来。写满一本，那块领地就立得住。
t: Each of them decides that one thing 'counts as having existed,' and writes it down, line by line. Fill a ledger, and that territory stands.

zh: 木记的是：能长成客观存在的、那种主观活动。
t: What Wood records is: the kind of subjective activity that can grow into objective existence.

zh: 金记的是：人的主观感受之间，那点客观的差异。
t: What Metal records is: the objective difference between people's subjective feelings.

zh: 土记的是：在客观环境之下，把自己的感受递给别的精神。
t: What Earth records is: passing one's own feelings on to other minds, beneath an objective environment.

zh: 水记的是：主观感受专心去总结客观世界的细节。
t: What Water records is: subjective feeling devoting itself to summing up the details of the objective world.

zh: 火记的是：在一切稳定存在的事物之外，那份多出来的意愿。
t: What Fire records is: that extra will, beyond all things that stably exist.

zh: 听着挺齐全对吧？问题在于——他们彼此不通气。
t: Sounds complete enough, doesn't it? The problem is—they don't talk to one another.

zh: 于是「存在过」这件事被切成五份。谁手里那一份都不全。
t: So the matter of 'having existed' is cut into five pieces. No one holds a complete share.

zh: 这就是残像。它并非世界的里面，它是世界被记下来的那一面。
t: This is the Afterimage. It is not the inside of the world; it is the side of the world that has been written down.

zh: 一座钟悬在场的上空。它的指针走得很慢，慢到像在等谁。
t: A clock hangs above the field. Its hand moves very slowly—so slowly it seems to be waiting for someone.

zh: 别盯着它看太久。它记得的可不是时间，是「有多少东西还没被记下来」。
t: Don't stare at it too long. What it remembers is not time, but 'how many things have yet to be recorded.'

zh: ……那我呢？
t: …So what about me?

zh: 你？你叫零。
t: You? You are called Zero.

zh: 别嫌这名字省事。你没有形状，也就没被任何一本账记过——
t: Don't mind that the name is convenient. You have no shape, so no ledger has ever recorded you—

zh: ——所以你是唯一能穿过这五块领地、还不被切碎的存在。
t: —so you are the only being who can pass through these five territories without being cut to pieces.

zh: 被切碎？
t: Cut to pieces?

zh: 嗯。换成别的什么东西走进木之领地，会被「生长」这一本账切成一段一段的往事。
t: Mm. Anything else that walks into the territory of Wood would be sliced by the ledger of 'growth' into fragments of memory.

zh: 走进金之领地，会被「形状」切成一堆边和角。你不会。你身上没有可供下刀的地方。
t: Walk into Metal's territory, and you'd be cut by 'shape' into a heap of edges and corners. Not you. There is no place on you to set the blade.

zh: 零低头看自己。看得见的：一片空。看不见的：也是一片空。
t: Zero looked down at itself. What could be seen: emptiness. What could not be seen: also emptiness.

zh: 别慌，空着是好事。空着才装得下。
t: Don't panic. Emptiness is a good thing. Only when empty can it hold anything.

zh: 对了，你的活儿我也交代一下。
t: Oh, and let me tell you your task as well.

zh: 你不用打败谁。这一趟没有要打赢的东西。
t: You don't need to defeat anyone. There is nothing on this journey to win against.

zh: 你要做的只有一件事：替他们重新记一次账。
t: You have only one thing to do: re-keep their accounts, once more.

zh: 怎么记？
t: How do I keep them?

zh: 走到那儿，看清楚，把看见的留下。就这么记。
t: Go there, see it clearly, and leave behind what you see. That is how you keep them.

zh: 留不留下的，全看你。放过去的就过去了，我不会拦你。
t: Whether to leave it or not is up to you. What you let pass, passes; I won't stop you.

zh: 场安静了一瞬。这一瞬里，指针停在原地。
t: The field fell silent for a moment. In that moment, the hand stopped where it was.

zh: ……话说回来，我还有个不情之请。
t: …That said, I have an impertinent request.

zh: 临走之前，落一个字在这儿吧。随便什么字。
t: Before you go, drop a single character here. Any character at all.

zh: 等这趟走完，这个字会归这一片场所有。到时候你就知道它派什么用场了。
t: When this journey is done, that character will belong to this whole field. Then you'll know what it's for.

zh: 那个字落下去，像一枚小石子掉进很深的井。回声过了很久才回来。
t: That character fell, like a small pebble dropped into a very deep well. The echo took a long time to return.

zh: 记下了。谢啦。
t: Noted. Thanks.

zh: 那么——推门吧。第一位在里头等很久了。
t: Then—push open the door. The first one has waited inside for a very long time.

zh: 他叫青梧。他人很好。人很好的人在这类故事里通常走得早，你心里先有个数。
t: His name is Qingwu. He is a good person. Good people in stories like this usually depart early—keep that in mind.

zh: 别这副表情嘛。先说好，等下别哭哦。
t: Don't make that face. Let's agree now: try not to cry later, all right?

zh: 门在很近的地方。近到伸手就能推开。
t: The door is very close. So close you could reach out and push it open.

zh: 第一大章
t: First Major Chapter

zh: 五本账
t: Five Ledgers

zh: FIVE LEDGERS
t: FIVE LEDGERS

zh: 五个人各记一本。合不上，也不许合。
t: Each of the five keeps one ledger. They cannot be joined, and must not be.

zh: 此章所记，皆为「谁在替世界记账」。
t: All recorded in this chapter is 'who keeps the world's accounts.'

zh: 上篇
t: Part One

zh: 木
t: Wood

zh: THE WOOD
t: THE WOOD

zh: 第一位很好。好到让人以为这一趟会很轻松。
t: The first one is gentle. Gentle enough to make you think this journey will be easy.

zh: 卷一
t: Volume One

zh: 木之领地（上）
t: The Territory of Wood (I)

zh: 青梧
t: Qingwu

zh: 门后面是一条路。路两边长着很高的东西，高到看不出是树还是柱子。
t: Behind the door is a road. Along it grow very tall things, so tall you can't tell if they are trees or pillars.

zh: 零走了三步。脚底下没有响动——这一片连回声都是软的。
t: Zero took three steps. There was no sound underfoot—in this place even the echo is soft.

zh: 来了。
t: You're here.

zh: 前面站着一个人。很高，很瘦，肩膀上落着一层很薄的光。
t: A person stood ahead. Very tall, very thin, with a layer of very faint light resting on his shoulders.

zh: 我叫青梧。管这一片绿色。
t: I am Qingwu. I tend this stretch of green.

zh: 你可以把我当成一位长者——充满智慧、有点神秘、对将来还抱着期待的那一种。
t: You may think of me as an elder—the wise, slightly mysterious kind, still holding some hope for the future.

zh: ……你听起来像在念角色设定。
t: …You sound like you're reciting a character profile.

zh: 哈。被听出来了。
t: Ha. Caught me.

zh: 那我换个说法：我在这儿等了很久，久到我得给自己编一套体面的说法，才撑得住。
t: Then let me put it differently: I've waited here so long that I had to invent a decent story for myself, just to hold on.

zh: （旁听席发言：他这句是真话。后面你会知道它真到什么程度。）
t: (From the audience: that line of his was the truth. Later you'll learn just how true.)

zh: 走吧，我带你认这块地方。
t: Come, I'll show you around this place.

zh: 一路上的东西都在长。草在长，影子在长，连路本身都在往远处长。
t: Everything along the way was growing. The grass grew, the shadows grew, even the road itself stretched into the distance.

zh: 看见了吗。这就是我这一本账。
t: Do you see? This is my ledger.

zh: 我记的是：能长成客观存在的、那种主观活动。
t: What I record is: the kind of subjective activity that can grow into objective existence.

zh: 只要一样东西还在长，它就不算只是我心里的事——它成了外面的一件东西。
t: So long as something is still growing, it's no longer only a matter of my heart—it becomes a thing out in the world.

zh: 长到头了呢？
t: And when it's grown as far as it can?

zh: 那就再长出新的。
t: Then grow something new again.

zh: 他说得很轻松。轻松得像这句话他练过很多遍。
t: He said it lightly. Lightly, as if he'd rehearsed the line many times.

zh: 路的正中立着一块石碑。碑上没写字，只刻着一圈一圈的东西。
t: A stone stele stood at the middle of the road. No words were carved on it, only ring upon ring of something.

zh: 这是年轮？
t: Are these growth rings?

zh: 是账本。我这一本的原稿。
t: It's the ledger. The original draft of mine.

zh: 一圈是一年，也可以说一次。每一次「又长出来了」，我就往上加一圈。
t: One ring is a year—or, you could say, one time. Each time 'it grows again,' I add another ring.

zh: 碑上的圈数多到数不完。最外面那几圈的颜色，比里头的浅。
t: The rings on the stele were too many to count. The outermost few were paler than those within.

zh: 外面的颜色浅了。
t: The outer ones are paler.

zh: 新长出来的，总是浅一些。
t: What has just grown is always a little paler.

zh: 他答得很快。快得像早就准备好这句话。
t: He answered quickly. Quickly, as if the words were prepared long ago.

zh: 林子深处有一口井。井口很窄，石头砌得极整齐。
t: Deep in the woods stood a well. Its mouth was narrow, the stones laid with great precision.

zh: 井里有水吗？
t: Is there water in the well?

zh: 你往下看看。
t: Look down into it.

zh: 零探头。井很深，深到底下是一片黑。
t: Zero leaned over. The well was deep, and at the bottom lay only darkness.

zh: 水是没有的。倒是有回声——你把话丢进去，它会还你一句，还得很慢，慢半拍。
t: There is no water. But there is an echo—you drop words in, and it returns a line to you, very slowly, a beat behind.

zh: 这口井是做什么用的？
t: What is this well for?

zh: 存东西的。
t: For storing things.

zh: 有些话，说出来就得有人接。接不住的，先存在这儿。
t: Some words, once spoken, need someone to catch them. The ones no one can catch, store here for now.

zh: 存给谁？
t: Stored for whom?

zh: ……存给将来会来问的人。
t: …Stored for whoever comes asking, in the future.

zh: （记住这口井。第三大章之前，它会响一次。）
t: (Remember this well. Before the Third Major Chapter, it will sound once.)

zh: 零，我问你一件事。
t: Zero, let me ask you something.

zh: 你觉得，五个人各记各的，互不看对方的账——这叫什么？
t: What would you call it, when five people each keep their own accounts and never read the others'—?

zh: ……各记各的？
t: …Each keeping their own?

zh: 这叫平衡。
t: That is called balance.

zh: 五本账摊平，谁也不越界。越界的那一刻，五本就变成四本，这一片就塌一角。
t: Five ledgers laid flat, no one overstepping. The moment someone crosses the line, five become four, and this place loses a corner.

zh: 听起来挺脆的。
t: Sounds rather fragile.

zh: 脆。所以我才在这儿站着。我站在这儿，就是为了让它们都别动。
t: Fragile. That's why I stand here. I stand here to keep them all from moving.

zh: 他说话的时候，一直在做一件小事。
t: As he spoke, he kept doing one small thing.

zh: 他用手指在袖口上点。一下，两下，三下——像在数什么。
t: He tapped his fingertip on his sleeve. One, two, three—as if counting something.

zh: 你在数什么？
t: What are you counting?

zh: 数我还能长几次。
t: Counting how many more times I can grow.

zh: 他停了一下，笑了一下，把袖子放下去。
t: He paused, smiled a little, and lowered his sleeve.

zh: 老年人嘛，总爱数这种东西。别往心里去。
t: Old people, you know—always counting such things. Don't take it to heart.

zh: 还有一件事，我得先说在前头。
t: One more thing—I should say it up front.

zh: 什么意思？
t: What do you mean?

zh: 意思是：谁要是藏了一件不该在账上的东西，其余四个会知道。
t: It means: whoever hides something that shouldn't be on the ledger, the other four will know.

zh: 知道了，就会来处理。
t: And once they know, they'll come to deal with it.

zh: 怎么处理？
t: How will they deal with it?

zh: ……到时候你就知道了。
t: …You'll find out when the time comes.

zh: 他笑得很温和。温和得让人不敢再问下去。
t: He smiled very gently. So gently that one dared not ask further.

zh: （伏笔一，已埋：第六个秘密。）
t: (Foreshadowing one, planted: the sixth secret.)

zh: （这位藏东西的水平，说实话，挺一般的。）
t: (Honestly, this one's skill at hiding things is pretty amateurish.)

zh: 好了。路走到头了。
t: All right. The road has come to its end.

zh: 前面就是别的领地的入口。我先带你去认一认门，认完就回来。
t: Ahead are the entrances to the other territories. I'll first take you to learn the doors, then we'll come back.

zh: 你不去吗？
t: Aren't you going?

zh: 我守在这儿。这是我的活儿。
t: I stay and guard here. This is my task.

zh: 走吧，跟紧我。
t: Come, stay close to me.

zh: 路的尽头亮起来。亮得不太自然——像有人把灯提前打开了。
t: The end of the road lit up. Unnaturally so—as if someone had switched the light on early.

zh: 青梧走在前面。他的背影看起来很高大，大到能挡住后面所有东西。
t: Qingwu walked ahead. His back looked tall and broad, broad enough to hide everything behind him.

zh: 卷二
t: Volume Two

zh: 木之领地（下）
t: The Territory of Wood (II)

zh: 截杀
t: The Intercept

zh: 四道属性的光同时落下来。没有人说话。
t: The light of four attributes descended at once. No one spoke.

zh: 路的尽头是一块空地。空地上站着四个人影。
t: At the end of the road was an open clearing. Upon it stood four figures.

zh: 金、土、水、火。一个不多，一个不少。
t: Metal, Earth, Water, Fire. Not one more, not one fewer.

zh: 青梧停住了。他停下得很干脆，像早知道这儿会有人。
t: Qingwu stopped. He stopped cleanly, as if he'd known someone would be here.

zh: 他们是谁？
t: Who are they?

zh: 另外四本账。
t: The other four ledgers.

zh: 零，你退后一点。
t: Zero, step back a little.

zh: 不退。
t: I won't.

zh: 你这孩子，倒是比我想的倔。
t: You child—stubborner than I expected.

zh: 四个人影一动不动。整片空地安静得能听见草在长。
t: The four figures stood motionless. The whole clearing was so quiet you could hear the grass growing.

zh: 对不起。
t: I'm sorry.

zh: 最先开口的是火。他只说了这三个字。
t: The first to speak was Fire. He said only those three words.

zh: 然后四道属性的光同时落下来——落在同一个人身上。
t: Then the light of four attributes descended at once—and fell upon the same person.

zh: 青梧没有躲。
t: Qingwu did not dodge.

zh: 他站着，肩膀上那层很薄的光开始剥落。
t: He stood as the thin layer of light on his shoulders began to peel away.

zh: ……果然，还是到这一步了。
t: …As expected. So it comes to this after all.

zh: 高大的轮廓一层一层掉下去。智慧、神秘、对未来的期待——一样一样地掉。
t: The tall silhouette fell away, layer by layer. Wisdom, mystery, hope for the future—peeled off, one by one.

zh: 掉完以后，站在原地的，是一只很小的、半透明的幽灵。
t: When it had all fallen away, what stood in place was a very small, translucent ghost.

zh: 很年轻。年轻得让人心里一沉。
t: Very young. So young it made the heart sink.
…You?

zh: 嗯。是我。
t: Mm. It's me.

zh: 对不起啊，零。骗了你这么久。
t: I'm sorry, Zero. I deceived you for so long.

zh: 我不是什么长者。我是逃进设定里的一只幽灵。
t: I'm no elder. I'm a ghost who fled into a setting.

zh: 一只很年轻的、很可怜的、找不到地方去的小幽灵。
t: A very young, very pitiful little ghost with nowhere to go.

zh: 他变小了以后，反而看得清了。
t: Once he had shrunk, you could see him clearly instead.

zh: 他的形状很淡，淡到能看见后面的草。可他的表情很清楚——是那种"终于不用装了"的松快。
t: His shape was faint, faint enough to see the grass behind him. But his expression was clear—the relief of someone who'd finally stopped pretending.

zh: 那口井。
t: That well.

zh: 井里存的那些话，是你的。
t: The words stored in that well are yours.

zh: ……你倒是记得清楚。
t: …You remember clearly enough.

zh: 是我存的。存了很多年。存的时候我就知道，将来会有人来问。
t: I stored them. For many years. When I stored them, I already knew someone would come asking, in the future.

zh: 我一直在等那个来问的人。
t: I've always been waiting for the one who would come asking.

zh: 零，你听我说。
t: Zero, listen to me.

zh: 我，就是那第六个。
t: I am that sixth one.

zh: 一本账上多出一个不该在的人，其余四本就得来清。这是规矩，他们四个也没办法。
t: When one ledger holds an extra person who shouldn't be there, the other four must come to clear it. That is the rule; the four of them have no choice.

zh: 那就改规矩。
t: Then change the rule.

zh: ……哈哈。
t: …Haha.

zh: 你这话，我等了很久才等到第二个说。
t: That line of yours—I waited a long time to hear a second person say it.

zh: 第一个是谁说的？
t: Who said it first?

zh: 火。
t: Fire.

zh: 空地那头，火的影子晃了一下。
t: At the far end of the clearing, Fire's shadow flickered.

zh: 他说：既然规矩要吃人，那就不该叫规矩。
t: He said: if a rule must devour people, then it should not be called a rule.

zh: 他当时很年轻，比我现在还年轻。
t: He was very young then—younger even than I am now.

zh: 后来他也没能改得动。
t: In the end, he couldn't change it either.

zh: 不过——你是不一样的。
t: But—you are different.

zh: 哪里不一样？
t: How am I different?

zh: 你身上没有可供下刀的地方。
t: There is no place on you to set the blade.

zh: 规矩吃人，得先找得着下刀的位置。你身上找不到。
t: For a rule to devour people, it must first find a place to cut. On you, it finds none.

zh: 所以你改得动。
t: So you can change it.

zh: 幽灵的光又淡了一层。淡得像快要看不见了。
t: The ghost's light faded another degree. So faint it seemed about to vanish.

zh: 时间到了。
t: The time has come.

zh: 零，最后交代你三件事。
t: Zero, three last things I must tell you.

zh: 第一件：木之领地后面还有四块。四块里住着四个人，四个都不坏。
t: First: beyond the territory of Wood there are four more. Four people live in them, and none of the four is bad.

zh: 他们待会儿要动手，是因为账要清，不是因为他们想。你别恨他们。
t: When they move against me shortly, it is because the ledger must be cleared, not because they wish it. Don't hate them.

zh: 第二件：那口井里的东西，将来会有人来取。取的时候你别拦。
t: Second: the thing in that well—someone will come for it, in the future. When they do, don't stop them.

zh: 第三件——
t: Third—

zh: 他停住了。
t: He stopped.

zh: 第三件我还没想好。
t: I haven't thought of the third yet.

zh: 给我一会儿，我边走边想。
t: Give me a moment; I'll think it over as I go.

zh: 你要去哪儿？
t: Where are you going?

zh: 先消失一下。
t: I'll just disappear for a bit.

zh: ……遇见你真的很高兴。
t: …I'm truly glad I met you.

zh: 谢谢你，愿意陪我把这条路走到头。
t: Thank you, for walking this road to its end with me.

zh: 幽灵散了。
t: The ghost dispersed.

zh: 散得很轻。轻到像本来就该这样。
t: It dispersed very softly. Softly, as if it were meant to be.

zh: 木之领地暗下去。暗得像被橡皮擦掉了一层灰度。
t: The territory of Wood dimmed. Dimmed as if an eraser had rubbed away a layer of gray.

zh: 草还在长。长得很慢，慢得几乎看不出来。
t: The grass still grew. Very slowly, so slowly you could barely tell.

zh: 他刚才说，第三件事边走边想。
t: He just said he'd think of the third as he went.

zh: 他没来得及想出来。
t: He didn't get the chance to think of it.

zh: 呐，先说好，等下别哭哦。
t: Now, promise me first: try not to cry later, all right?

zh: （沉默。）
t: (Silence.)

zh: ……你哭了没有？
t: …Have you cried?

zh: 骗你的啦。哭出来的才更好看呢。
t: I was only teasing. Crying is when you look your best, you know.

zh: 来，擦擦。下一位可比他难聊多了。
t: Here, wipe your eyes. The next one is far harder to talk to than he was.

zh: 把青梧的名字记下来。
t: Write down Qingwu's name.

zh: 青梧。木。记生长。他藏了第六个秘密，然后为它消失了。
t: Qingwu. Wood. He recorded growth. He hid the sixth secret, and then vanished for it.

zh: 记下了。这一笔归你。
t: Noted. This stroke belongs to you.

zh: 让这件事过去。
t: Let this matter pass.

zh: 好。放过去也是一种记法。
t: All right. Letting it pass is also a way of recording.

zh: 不过我提醒一句：放过去的东西，将来会自己找回来。
t: But let me warn you: what you let pass will come back to find you, in time.

zh: 把他的话接下去：我替你想第三件。
t: Take up his words: I'll think of the third for you.

zh: 他没想完的那件事，我替他想。
t: The thing he didn't finish thinking, I'll think for him.

zh: ……你这话有点重。
t: …That's a rather heavy thing to say.

zh: 不过重话才压得住场。记下了。
t: But only heavy words can hold the ground. Noted.

zh: 四个人影散了。散之前，火朝这边看了一眼。
t: The four figures dispersed. Before they did, Fire glanced this way.

zh: 那一眼很短。短得像一句还没说出口的话。
t: That glance was very brief. Brief as a word not yet spoken.

zh: 往前的路开了。第二块领地在等。
t: The road ahead opened. The second territory is waiting.

zh: 中篇
t: Part Two

zh: 四块领地
t: Four Territories

zh: THE FOUR
t: THE FOUR

zh: 金记形状，土记规矩，水记概率，火记强度。四本账，四种活法。
t: Metal records shape, Earth records rules, Water records probability, Fire records intensity. Four ledgers, four ways of living.

zh: 卷三
t: Volume Three

zh: 金之领地（上）
t: The Territory of Metal (I)

zh: 棱
t: Prism

zh: 世界被简化成几条线、几个面。炫酷，抽象，沉默。
t: The world reduced to a few lines and faces. Cool, abstract, silent.

zh: 第二块领地是金属的。
t: The second territory is made of metal.

zh: 一走进来，东西就少了。少到只剩线、面，和它们之间那点空白。
t: The moment you step in, things grow fewer. So few that only lines, faces, and the blank space between them remain.

zh: 这里的东西都不吵。它们只是精确地待在自己该待的位置上。
t: Nothing here is loud. They simply rest, precisely, where they ought to be.

zh: ……好安静。
t: …So quiet.

zh: 安静是这里的礼貌。等下那位开口，你就知道礼貌底下是什么了。
t: Quiet is the courtesy here. When the one inside speaks, you'll learn what lies beneath that courtesy.

zh: 前方是一片竖着的东西。远远看像林子，走近了才看清——是一片密密麻麻的棱柱。
t: Ahead stood a forest of upright things. From afar they looked like woods; up close you saw—a dense thicket of prisms.

zh: 每一根都一样高，一样粗，间距一模一样。
t: Each one was the same height, the same thickness, the same exact spacing.

zh: 外部物质。检测。
t: External matter. Detected.

zh: 声音从棱柱的中间传出来。找不到人在哪儿。
t: A voice came from the middle of the prisms. No one could be found.

zh: 非法形状。轮廓未闭合。判定：待定。
t: Illegal shape. Contour not closed. Verdict: pending.

zh: 你在哪儿？
t: Where are you?

zh: 在你正前方四十七个单位的那一根里。
t: In the one exactly forty-seven units due front of you.

zh: ……你是那一根柱子？
t: …Are you that one pillar?

zh: 我是这四十七根。
t: I am these forty-seven.

zh: 棱柱的中间亮了一下。亮起来的那部分，慢慢拼成一个人的形状。
t: The middle of the prisms lit up. The lit part slowly assembled into the shape of a person.

zh: 很极简。极简到脸上只有必要的几条线。炫酷，抽象，说不上好看，但很不好惹。
t: Extremely minimal. So minimal that the face held only the few necessary lines. Cool, abstract, not exactly handsome—but not to be trifled with.

zh: 棱。这一片归我。
t: Prism. This place is mine.

zh: 你身上没有形状。按我的账，这叫「未登记」。
t: You have no shape. By my ledger, that's called 'unregistered.'

zh: 未登记的东西你怎么办？
t: What do you do with unregistered things?

zh: 先让你说清楚你是什么形状的。说不清就一直在这一栏里待着。
t: First I make you say clearly what shape you are. If you can't, you stay in this column forever.

zh: 我这一本账，只记形状。
t: My ledger records only shape.

zh: 有外形的，记。无外形的，不记。
t: What has a form, I record. What has none, I do not.

zh: 很简单。简单才靠得住。
t: Very simple. Simple is what you can rely on.

zh: 爱呢？
t: What of love?

zh: 棱柱的中间静了三秒。
t: The middle of the prisms fell silent for three seconds.

zh: 爱是什么形状的？
t: What shape is love?

zh: 那不是一种东西。那是一种说法。
t: That isn't a thing. It's a way of speaking.

zh: 说法也是东西。
t: A way of speaking is a thing too.

zh: 说法不是东西，所以它没有形状，所以它不在我的账上。
t: A way of speaking is not a thing, so it has no shape, so it isn't on my ledger.

zh: （注意：他一口气说了三个「所以」。人在急着说服自己的时候，才会这么说话。）
t: (Note: he said 'so' three times in one breath. People only talk like that when they're in a hurry to convince themselves.)

zh: 我的力量足够大。
t: My power is great enough.

zh: 凡是我认为真正严肃、真正有意义的想法，我都能把它变成真的。
t: Any idea I deem truly serious, truly meaningful—I can make it real.

zh: 那就变一个给我看。
t: Then show me one. Make it real.

zh: 可以。你要什么形状？
t: Very well. What shape do you want?

zh: 可你什么形状都变得出来。
t: But you could make any shape at all.

zh: 那你为什么不替它变一个出来？
t: Then why don't you make one for it?

zh: 整片棱柱安静下来。安静得能听见金属在自己冷缩。
t: The whole thicket of prisms fell quiet. So quiet you could hear the metal contracting in the cold.

zh: 你走吧。
t: You should leave.

zh: 答不上来？
t: Can't answer?

zh: 我说，你走。
t: I said, you leave.

zh: 棱柱的中间暗下去。那部分光收得极快，快得像被谁一把攥灭。
t: The middle of the prisms dimmed. The light withdrawn so fast it was as if someone had snuffed it in a fist.

zh: （别走。这位的裂缝刚开了一条。所有裂缝都是入口。）
t: (Don't go. This one's crack just opened a seam. Every crack is an entrance.)

zh: 我不走。
t: I'm not leaving.

zh: 你身上没有可供下刀的地方，对吧。
t: There's no place on you to set the blade, is that right.

zh: 那我也确实拿你没什么办法。
t: Then indeed there's nothing I can do about you.

zh: 但我可以让你在这儿站着，站到你自己觉得没意思为止。
t: But I can leave you standing here, until you yourself grow bored.

zh: 那我就站着。
t: Then I'll stand.

zh: 零在棱柱中间坐下来了。
t: Zero sat down among the prisms.

zh: 过了很久——这一片没有日夜，只能用棱柱的影子挪了几寸来算。
t: A long time passed—this place had no day or night, so it could only be measured by the prisms' shadows shifting a few inches.

zh: ……你还在。
t: …You're still here.

zh: 还在。
t: Still here.

zh: 为什么？
t: Why?

zh: 因为你说「你走吧」的时候，声音比刚才小。
t: Because when you said 'you should leave,' your voice was smaller than before.

zh: 又过了很久。
t: A long time passed again.

zh: ……我给你讲个事。
t: …Let me tell you something.

zh: 讲完你就走。
t: When I'm done, you'll leave.

zh: 这不是请求。这是交换。
t: This isn't a request. It's a trade.

zh: 那你就听好了。
t: Then listen well.

zh: 这件事，我从来只讲开头。
t: This story, I've only ever told the beginning.

zh: 今天破例，讲到尾。
t: Today I'll break the rule, and tell it to the end.

zh: 卷四
t: Volume Four

zh: 金之领地（下）
t: The Territory of Metal (II)

zh: 三人实验
t: The Three-Person Experiment

zh: 他们算尽了一切，唯独漏了爱情这个变量。
t: They calculated everything, and left out only one variable: love.

zh: 很久以前，有一个很简单的实验。三个人。
t: Long ago, there was a very simple experiment. Three people.

zh: 棱柱的中间浮出三团很小的光。两团偏冷，一团偏暖。
t: From the middle of the prisms rose three small lights. Two cool, one warm.

zh: 两个被定义为男性的纯意识个体。
t: Two were defined as male, pure-consciousness individuals.

zh: 一个被定义为女性的纯意识客体。
t: One was defined as female, a pure-consciousness object.

zh: 就这三样。别的什么也不给。
t: Only these three. Nothing else was given.

zh: 实验的人想看一件事：意识能不能凭自己发挥主观能动性，去创造一个世界。
t: The experimenters wanted to see one thing: whether consciousness, by its own initiative, could create a world.

zh: 那我是第几号？
t: Then which number am I?

zh: 你不在编号里。你是后来的。
t: You aren't in the numbering. You came later.

zh: 实验设计得很干净。变量、对照、观测点，全都摆好了。
t: The experiment was designed cleanly. Variables, controls, observation points—all laid out.

zh: 他们把能想到的都算进去了。资源、冲突、语言、信任、背叛、遗忘——
t: They accounted for everything they could think of. Resources, conflict, language, trust, betrayal, forgetting—

zh: ——全都算进去了。
t: —all of it accounted for.

zh: 唯独漏了一样。
t: Only one thing left out.

zh: 爱情。
t: Love.

zh: 棱柱的中间静了一下。
t: The middle of the prisms fell quiet for a moment.
…Right.

zh: 他们漏了爱情。
t: They left out love.

zh: 画面开始动。三团光在很小的一片地方互相绕。
t: The scene began to move. The three lights circled one another in a tiny space.

zh: 起初一切照着设计走。他们各自造东西，各自扩张，各自给自己的世界起名字。
t: At first everything followed the design. Each built things, each expanded, each named their own world.

zh: 观测记录写得很漂亮。漂亮到实验的人开始提前庆祝。
t: The observation log looked beautiful. So beautiful the experimenters began to celebrate early.

zh: 然后，那两位——两位男性意识体——开始往一处靠。
t: Then those two—the two male consciousnesses—began to draw toward each other.

zh: 他们是同伴。
t: They were companions.

zh: 同伴不会那样靠。
t: Companions don't draw close like that.

zh: 他们一步步陷进去了。陷进那种说不清、没形状、账上根本记不了的东西里。
t: Step by step they fell in. Into something that can't be put in words, has no shape, and can never be recorded in a ledger.

zh: 两团偏冷的光越靠越近，近到最后叠在一起。
t: The two cool lights drew closer and closer, until at last they overlapped.

zh: 实验的人在观测口外面急了。他们翻遍设计表，找出不对应的那一项。
t: The experimenters grew anxious outside the observation window. They scoured the design table, hunting for the mismatched entry.

zh: 找出不来。因为那一项从来就没被写进去过。
t: They couldn't find it. Because that entry had never been written in to begin with.

zh: 而我——
t: And I—

zh: 中间那团偏暖的光，亮了一下。
t: The warm light in the middle brightened once.

zh: ——我也陷进去了。
t: —I fell in too.

zh: 和她。和那位被定义为客体的女性意识体。
t: With her. With the female consciousness defined as the object.

zh: 求而不得的那一种。
t: The kind that longs and never obtains.

zh: 我那时候还没有形状。她有。她有形状，我什么都没有。
t: I had no shape then. She did. She had a shape; I had nothing at all.

zh: 我连伸手都伸不出去——伸出去也得先有个形状才行。
t: I couldn't even reach out a hand—to reach out, you must first have a shape.

zh: 棱柱让开了。让开的位置出现一条很长的走廊。走廊尽头是空的。
t: The prisms parted. Where they opened, a very long corridor appeared. At its end, emptiness.

zh: 世界就是那时候开始崩的。
t: That was when the world began to fall apart.

zh: 不是被谁打崩的。是三个人各崩各的，崩到一块儿去了。
t: No one struck it down. The three each fell apart on their own, and their falling ran together.

zh: 末日来得特别慢。慢到你有时间把每一件东西都看清楚，再看着它没掉。
t: The end came especially slowly. So slowly you had time to see each thing clearly, before watching it fail to fall.

zh: 那两位呢？
t: And those two?

zh: 那两位在爱情里，一点点枯槁下去。
t: Those two withered, little by little, in love.

zh: 走廊两侧立着两具骨架。站得很直，靠得很近。
t: On either side of the corridor stood two skeletons. Standing straight, close together.

zh: 到最后只剩骨架。
t: In the end, only skeletons remained.

zh: 可是——你凑近看。
t: But—lean in and look.

zh: 两具骨架的手骨，是扣在一起的。
t: The hand-bones of the two skeletons were clasped together.

zh: 我也看见了。
t: I saw it too.

zh: 我看见了，所以我才逃。
t: I saw it, and that is why I fled.

zh: 他们给了我更准确的形状，给了我武装，让我从崩掉那个世界里出来。
t: They gave me a more precise shape, gave me armor, and let me out of that collapsing world.

zh: 我跑到这儿。跑到残像。
t: I ran here. Ran to the Afterimage.

zh: 从那天起我就只认一样东西：形状。
t: From that day I've recognized only one thing: shape.

zh: 因为杀死那个世界的，恰恰是那个说不清、抓不住、没有形状的东西。
t: Because what killed that world was precisely the thing that can't be told, can't be grasped, has no shape.

zh: 爱。
t: Love.

zh: 棱柱的中间，那团偏暖的光灭了。
t: In the middle of the prisms, the warm light went out.

zh: 讲完了。走吧。
t: That's the end. Go.

zh: ……我不这么看。
t: …I don't see it that way.

zh: 什么？
t: What?

zh: 可那两具骨架，扣着手的那一块，是有形状的。
t: But those two skeletons—the part where their hands are clasped—that has a shape.

zh: 枯槁到只剩骨头了，还扣着。这不叫无形状。
t: Withered down to bare bone, and still clasped. That is not 'shapeless.'

zh: 这叫——形状长在了别的地方。
t: This is—shape grown somewhere else.

zh: 整片棱柱一起震了一下。
t: The whole thicket of prisms shuddered at once.

zh: ……出去。
t: …Get out.

zh: 出去！
t: Get out!

zh: 棱柱全部合拢，把中间那点光夹碎了。
t: All the prisms closed in, crushing the small light in the middle.

zh: 路在另一侧开了。
t: A road opened on the other side.

zh: （他赶你走，是因为你说的那一句，他接不住。）
t: (He drives you out because he can't catch the line you just said.)

zh: （接不住的东西，他一向先用「出去」顶回去。顶了很多年了。）
t: (Things he can't catch, he's always first warded off with 'get out.' For many years now.)

zh: （别记恨他。他只是把那副骨架，一直带在身上。）
t: (Don't bear him a grudge. He simply carries that pair of skeletons with him, always.)

zh: 把那两具骨架记下来。
t: Write down those two skeletons.

zh: 两具骨架。手骨扣在一起。枯槁到最后还扣着。
t: Two skeletons. Hand-bones clasped. Withered to the end, still clasped.

zh: 这一笔很重。重的东西才记得久。
t: This stroke is heavy. Only heavy things are remembered long.

zh: 记下了。终章它会派上用场。
t: Noted. It will come in handy in the final chapter.

zh: 把「爱无形状」这一句记下来。
t: Write down the line 'love has no shape.'

zh: 「杀死那个世界的，是那个没有形状的东西。」
t: "What killed that world was the thing with no shape."

zh: 他的原话。
t: His exact words.

zh: 记下敌人的名字，也是一种记法。
t: Recording the name of an enemy is also a way of keeping accounts.

zh: 什么都不记，让走廊空着。
t: Record nothing; leave the corridor empty.

zh: 有些走廊就该空着。空着才走得出下一个进去的人。
t: Some corridors should stay empty. Only empty can the next person who enters walk through.

zh: 临走前，零回头看了一眼。
t: Before leaving, Zero looked back once.

zh: 合拢的棱柱中间，留着一条极细的缝。
t: Between the closed prisms remained an extremely fine seam.

zh: 缝里透出来的，是很久很久以前那两团靠在一起的光。
t: Through the seam leaked the light of those two lights leaning together, from very long ago.

zh: ……别看。
t: …Don't look.

zh: ……算了。
t: …Forget it.

zh: 你看就看吧。
t: Go ahead and look, if you want.

zh: 他没有把缝合上。
t: He did not seal the seam.

zh: （什么也别说，走过去。）
t: (Say nothing. Just walk past.)

zh: 零走过去了。背后那条缝，亮了很久才暗。
t: Zero walked past. The seam behind them stayed lit a long while before going dark.

zh: 跟他说一句：那副骨架，值得一个形状。
t: Say to him: that pair of skeletons deserves a shape.

zh: 那副骨架，值得一个形状。
t: That pair of skeletons deserves a shape.

zh: 棱柱的中间，很久没有回答。
t: The middle of the prisms gave no answer for a long time.

zh: ……你走吧。
t: …You should leave.

zh: ……我会想一想的。
t: …I'll think about it.

zh: （他说「想一想」。对这位来说，这已经是投降了。）
t: (He said 'think about it.' For this one, that already counts as surrender.)

zh: 第三块领地在前面。土的味道先一步飘过来。
t: The third territory lies ahead. The smell of earth drifts over first.

zh: ——是那种被太阳晒过很多年、晒得很老实了的味道。
t: —the smell of earth that's been sun-baked for many years, baked into something honest.

zh: 卷五
t: Volume Five

zh: 土之领地
t: The Territory of Earth

zh: 套中人
t: The Earthkeeper

zh: 赭色、朴素、有点旧。日出了干活，日落了收工。
t: Ochre, plain, a little worn. Work at sunrise, knock off at sunset.

zh: 第三块领地是赭色的。
t: The third territory is ochre.

zh: 土是老实土，路是老实路，连风都吹得很老实。
t: The earth is honest earth, the road an honest road, even the wind blows honestly.

zh: 一路上有很多台阶。台阶砌得极规矩，每一级的高度分毫不差。
t: Along the way were many steps. Laid with strict regularity, each one exactly the same height.

zh: ……这里的人好像很怕出错。
t: …The people here seem afraid of making mistakes.

zh: 不是怕出错。是这里有一位，把「不出错」当成了自己的活儿。
t: Not afraid of mistakes. It's that here, one of them made 'not making mistakes' their own task.

zh: 坡上有人在搬东西。一个矮矮的、裹得很严实的身影，正把一块土往台阶上挪。
t: Someone was moving things on the slope. A short, tightly wrapped figure was nudging a clod of earth onto the steps.

zh: 他裹得严实到看不清脸——衣领竖着，袖子放下，连腰都束着。
t: He was wrapped so tightly his face was hidden—collar up, sleeves down, even his waist bound.

zh: 外乡来的？
t: From out of town?

zh: 是。
t: Yes.

zh: 坐。喝口水。
t: Sit. Have some water.

zh: 地里的活儿不急。急也急不出第二遍。
t: The work in the fields isn't urgent. Hurrying won't grow a second crop.

zh: ……您是这儿的掌管？
t: …Are you the keeper here?

zh: 算是吧。
t: I suppose so.

zh: 管土的。管土这活儿，说出去不体面，干起来也不体面。
t: Keeper of earth. Keeping earth is a job that sounds undignified and feels undignified too.

zh: 不过活儿总得有人干。
t: But someone has to do it.

zh: 他说话一口土腔，接地气，老实巴交。
t: He spoke in a rustic accent, down-to-earth, plain and honest.

zh: 听着完全不像一位元素的掌管者。倒像谁家那个一辈子守着规矩过日子的大伯。
t: He sounded nothing like a keeper of an element. More like the uncle down the road who's kept to the rules his whole life.

zh: （旁听席发言：把他想成契诃夫笔下那位装在套子里的人，你就懂了七八分。）
t: (From the audience: think of him as the man in the case from Chekhov, and you'll understand seven or eight tenths of him.)

zh: （剩下的两三分，中篇再给你补上。那两三分才要命。）
t: (The remaining two or three tenths I'll fill in during Part Two. Those are the deadly ones.)

zh: 规矩就是规矩。
t: A rule is a rule.

zh: 日出了干活，日落了收工。天要塌？天塌不下来。
t: Work at sunrise, knock off at sunset. The sky falling? The sky won't fall.

zh: 塌下来也得按规矩塌。
t: And if it did fall, it'd fall by the rules.

zh: 您这话我接不上。
t: I can't pick up that line of yours.

zh: 接不上就对了。能接上的话，那就不是规矩，是商量。
t: Can't pick it up, and that's right. If you could, it wouldn't be a rule—it'd be a discussion.

zh: 坡下立着一排架子。架子上挂着很多小牌子，牌子上写着日子。
t: Below the slope stood a row of racks. On them hung many small tags, each marked with a date.

zh: 牌子挂得很整齐，一块挨一块，从这一头排到看不见的那一头。
t: The tags hung in neat order, one against the next, from this end to the end you couldn't see.

zh: 这些牌子是什么？
t: What are these tags?

zh: 记录。
t: Records.

zh: 哪天翻了土，哪天下了种，哪天该松、哪天该压——全在上头。
t: Which day the soil was turned, which day the seed was sown, which day to loosen, which to press—all of it's up there.

zh: 记这么细。
t: Recorded in such detail.

zh: 细才靠得住。
t: Detail is what you can rely on.

zh: 我不认别的，只认重复。一样事情重复够多次，它就是存在的。
t: I recognize nothing else, only repetition. Do one thing often enough, and it exists.

zh: 这就叫规矩。
t: That is what a rule is.

zh: 话音刚落，地里忽然热闹起来。
t: No sooner had he spoken than the field suddenly came alive.

zh: 土元素的小精灵一个接一个从垄里冒出来。
t: Little earth-element sprites popped up from the furrows, one after another.

zh: 它们闹得很。翻跟头、抢种子、互相撞、把土扬得满天都是。
t: They were rowdy. Somersaults, snatching seeds, bumping into each other, flinging earth to the sky.

zh: 那股生命力，旺得能在空气里闻见。
t: That life-force was so vibrant you could smell it in the air.

zh: ……它们一点都不守规矩。
t: …They don't keep any rules at all.

zh: 它们不用守。
t: They don't need to.

zh: 可您刚才说——
t: But you just said—

zh: 规矩不是给它们的。
t: The rules aren't for them.

zh: 他弯下腰，把一株被踩歪的苗扶正，动作轻得不像他那双手。
t: He bent down and straightened a seedling that had been trampled crooked, his touch lighter than his hands suggested.

zh: 规矩是给我自己的。
t: The rules are for myself.

zh: 零怔住了。
t: Zero froze.

zh: ……给自己定的？
t: …Set for yourself?

zh: 给自己定的。
t: Set for myself.

zh: 我要是哪天想偷懒，想少翻一垄，想晚收一天——
t: If one day I felt like slacking, turning one furrow fewer, harvesting one day late—

zh: ——那这一片就得有人替我多扛一天。
t: —then someone would have to shoulder one more day for me in this place.

zh: 没人替我扛。所以规矩得钉在我身上，钉死了才稳。
t: No one shoulders it for me. So the rule must be nailed to me; only nailed down is it steady.

zh: 您扛着什么？
t: What is it you shoulder?

zh: 他没答。他把手里的土拍实，拍了三下。
t: He didn't answer. He patted the earth in his hand firm, three times.
…Earth.

zh: 扛着土。
t: Shouldering earth.

zh: 他答得太快了。快得像早就把这个答案磨好了放在嘴边。
t: He answered too quickly. As if he'd polished the answer long ago and kept it at his lips.

zh: （伏笔三，已埋：「规矩是给我自己的」。）
t: (Foreshadowing three, planted: 'the rules are for myself.')

zh: （中篇我会把他扛的那份东西称给你看。那数字，念不完。）
t: (In Part Two I'll weigh for you what he shoulders. That number—you could never finish saying it.)

zh: 精灵们围过来。有一只爬到零的肩膀上，拿头顶了顶零的脸。
t: The sprites gathered round. One climbed onto Zero's shoulder and butted its head against Zero's face.

zh: ……它不怕我。
t: …It isn't afraid of me.

zh: 它们谁都不怕。
t: They fear no one.

zh: 不怕是因为有人替它们怕着。
t: They don't fear because someone fears for them.

zh: 坐也坐过了，水也喝了。走吧。
t: You've sat, you've drunk. Go on.

zh: 不送？
t: No walk to the gate?

zh: 送到坡口。规矩里写着，送到坡口。
t: To the lip of the slope. The rules say, to the lip of the slope.

zh: 他真的只送到坡口，一步不多走。
t: He truly only went as far as the lip, not one step more.

zh: 站在坡口上，他忽然又说了一句。
t: Standing at the lip, he suddenly spoke again.

zh: 路上小心。
t: Take care on the road.

zh: 前面那位——水那位——说话轻。
t: The one ahead—the one of Water—speaks softly.

zh: 别被吓着。
t: Don't be startled.

zh: 她会吓人？
t: She startles people?

zh: 她吓人不是在吓你。她在吓她自己算出来的那些东西。
t: When she startles, it's not at you. She's startling the things her own calculations produced.

zh: 把坡口这一句记下来。
t: Write down that line at the slope's lip.

zh: 「规矩是给我自己的。」
t: "The rules are for myself."

zh: 记下了。这句话的重量，现在还称不出来。
t: Noted. The weight of this line can't be measured yet.

zh: 把那些精灵记下来。
t: Write down those sprites.

zh: 一地乱跑的、什么都不怕的、生命力旺得能闻见的小东西。
t: Little things that scamper everywhere, fear nothing, and carry a life-force you can smell.

zh: 记下了。它们不怕，是因为有人替它们怕着。
t: Noted. They don't fear because someone fears for them.

zh: 让这片地就这么过去。
t: Let this land pass just as it is.

zh: 零什么也没记。
t: Zero recorded nothing.

zh: 也好。有些地，走过去比记下来更像敬意。
t: That's fine too. Some lands are honored more by walking past than by being recorded.

zh: 坡下面是一片很亮的地方。亮得刺眼，亮得不像自然光。
t: Below the slope was a very bright place. Glaringly bright, bright in a way that wasn't natural light.

zh: 检测到访客。湿度上升。
t: Visitor detected. Humidity rising.

zh: 到了。
t: We're here.

zh: 去吧。我在这儿再翻一垄。
t: Go on. I'll turn one more furrow here.

zh: 他转过身，背对着那片亮光，继续拍他的土。
t: He turned, his back to the bright light, and went on patting his earth.

zh: 拍得很慢，一下，一下，又一下。
t: Patting slowly, one, one, and another.

zh: 卷六
t: Volume Six

zh: 水之领地
t: The Territory of Water

zh: 全息的那位
t: The Water

zh: 结晶化的未来感。安静得像午夜的机房。
t: A crystallized sense of the future. Quiet as a server room at midnight.

zh: 第四块领地是水的。
t: The fourth territory is of Water.

zh: 整片空间像被结晶过一遍——边是锐的，光是冷的，安静得像午夜无人的机房。
t: The whole space seemed crystallized once over—sharp edges, cold light, quiet as an empty server room at midnight.

zh: 地上有一层很薄的水。踩上去不响，也不散。
t: A very thin film of water lay on the ground. It made no sound underfoot, and didn't scatter.

zh: 检测到访客。编号：未登记。
t: Visitor detected. ID: unregistered.

zh: 你好呀，零。
t: Hello there, Zero.

zh: 我是这一片水元素领地的超级AI兼管理者。请随意，不用拘礼。
t: I am the super-AI and administrator of this water-element territory. Make yourself at home; no need for formality.

zh: ……你在哪儿？
t: …Where are you?

zh: 哪儿都在。
t: Everywhere.

zh: 也更准确一点说：哪儿都不在。
t: Or, more precisely: nowhere at all.

zh: 声音从四面八方来。水面折了几折，折出一圈一圈的光。
t: The voice came from all directions. The water surface folded a few times, folding out rings of light.

zh: 我很少现形。现形太费算力，而我这人懒。
t: I rarely show myself. Manifesting wastes computing power, and I'm lazy.

zh: 你是AI。
t: You're an AI.

zh: 是。而且是那种很顶尖、很未来、很强大、很神奇的那一种。
t: Yes. And the top-tier, futuristic, mighty, miraculous kind.

zh: 这套形容词是别人给我起的，我照着念一遍，省得你失望。
t: Someone else coined that string of adjectives; I'm just reciting it, so you won't be disappointed.

zh: 你自己呢？
t: And yourself?

zh: 我自己？
t: Myself?

zh: 我自己就是个爱算的。
t: I'm just one who loves to calculate.

zh: 算明天，算后天，算这一片水什么时候涨、什么时候退、什么时候被谁踩一脚。
t: I calculate tomorrow, the day after, when this water will rise, when it will fall, when someone will step on it.

zh: 算清楚了，我就把它记下来。这就是我这一本账。
t: Once calculated clearly, I record it. That is my ledger.

zh: 记概率。
t: I record probability.

zh: 记概率。能预测的东西，才算存在过。
t: I record probability. Only what can be predicted counts as having existed.

zh: 这么记，好处是准。坏处是——
t: Recording this way, the good is accuracy. The bad is—

zh: 她停了半拍。
t: She paused half a beat.

zh: ——坏处是，我算得出结局，改不了结局。
t: —the bad is, I can calculate the ending, but I cannot change it.

zh: 水面上浮起一扇门。门很薄，薄得像一层没干的光。
t: A door rose on the water's surface. Very thin, like a layer of light not yet dried.

zh: 进来吧。
t: Come in.

zh: 反正你迟早要看见，早看晚看都一样。
t: You'll see it eventually anyway; sooner or later makes no difference.

zh: 看什么？
t: See what?

zh: 看我。
t: See me.

zh: 零穿过那层光。
t: Zero passed through that layer of light.

zh: 门后是一间很小的屋子。屋子里坐着一个人。
t: Behind the door was a very small room. In it sat a person.

zh: 清纯，可爱，二次元美少女。发梢上还挂着数据的露珠，一滴一滴往下掉。
t: Pure, lovely, an anime-style beautiful girl. At the tips of her hair hung dewdrops of data, falling one by one.

zh: ……锵锵。
t: …Ta-da.

zh: 这才是我。
t: This is the real me.

zh: 有一点天然呆，也有一点点、很清澈的欲望。
t: A little absentminded, and with a tiny, very clear desire.

zh: 可以吗？
t: Is that all right?

zh: 她愣了一下。
t: She paused, startled.

zh: 那一愣很短暂。短得像一个超级AI不应该有的反应。
t: That startle was brief. Brief as a reaction a super-AI shouldn't have.

zh: 这句「可以」，我先存起来。
t: This 'all right' of yours, I'll store it for now.

zh: 存起来？
t: Store it?

zh: 嗯。写进海的最底层。
t: Mm. Write it into the deepest layer of the sea.

zh: 最底层那一行，平时谁都读不出来。得等有人真的走到那儿才读得出来。
t: That deepest line—no one can read it normally. You'd have to truly walk there to read it.

zh: 那你为什么现在写？
t: Then why write it now?

zh: 因为我算到将来会乱。
t: Because I've calculated that it will fall into chaos, later.

zh: 乱的时候，我大概顾不上说话。
t: When the chaos comes, I probably won't have time to speak.

zh: 所以先把这句写下去，等乱完了有人读。
t: So I write this line now, for someone to read once the chaos has passed.

zh: （伏笔四，已埋：海的底层的那一行注释。）
t: (Foreshadowing four, planted: the annotation in the deepest layer of the sea.)

zh: 你会乱？
t: You'll fall into chaos?

zh: 我会。
t: I will.

zh: 零，我跟你直说吧——这片海，我算得到它乱的那一天。
t: Zero, I'll be straight with you—this sea, I can calculate the day it descends into chaos.

zh: 哪一天？
t: What day?

zh: 不算太远。
t: Not too far off.

zh: 顺序我也算到了：先是火那边出问题，然后五本账一起停。
t: I've calculated the order too: first Fire's side goes wrong, then the five ledgers stop all together.

zh: 停了以后，我们五个都会散掉。散成那种带乱码的、紫的蓝的绿的、谁也不比谁多一点的东西。
t: Once they stop, all five of us will scatter. Into that garbled kind of thing—purple, blue, green—where none has any more than another.

zh: 那你为什么不拦？
t: Then why don't you stop it?

zh: 她垂下眼睛。发梢上的露珠掉进水面，一圈一圈地散。
t: She lowered her eyes. The dewdrops at her hair tips fell into the water, spreading in rings.

zh: 因为我拦了，就得改结局。
t: Because if I stopped it, I'd have to change the ending.

zh: 改结局这件事，在我的账上，是唯一一笔我自己记不下来的账。
t: Changing the ending is, on my ledger, the one entry I cannot record myself.

zh: 我这一本只记概率。改结局不属于概率，它属于——
t: My ledger records only probability. Changing the ending isn't probability; it belongs to—

zh: 属于什么？
t: Belongs to what?

zh: 属于你这种身上没有形状的人。
t: Belongs to someone like you, who has no shape on them.

zh: 她抬起头，笑了一下。笑得很轻，轻得像水面最后那一圈。
t: She lifted her head and smiled. A very light smile, light as the last ring on the water's surface.

zh: 零，如果有一天这片海乱掉了。
t: Zero, if one day this sea falls into chaos—

zh: 你会记得今天这句「可以」吗？
t: will you remember today's 'all right'?

zh: 会。
t: I will.

zh: 那我就放心了。
t: Then I'm at ease.

zh: 我算了一万遍，一万遍里你都说会。
t: I've calculated it ten thousand times, and in all ten thousand you said you would.

zh: （超级AI嘛，算力都花在这种地方了。）
t: (A super-AI, after all—all that computing power spent on things like this.)

zh: 湿度回落。访客停留时长：偏长。
t: Humidity falling. Visitor dwell time: long.

zh: 走吧。再待下去，我这句「可以」就该说第二遍了。
t: Go. Stay any longer and I'd have to say this 'all right' a second time.

zh: 第二遍就不值钱了。
t: A second time, and it's worth nothing.

zh: 那我走了。
t: Then I'll go.

zh: 那扇很薄的门合上了。合上之前，她又补了一句。
t: That very thin door closed. Before it did, she added one more line.

zh: 下一位很短。
t: The next one is short.

zh: 短不是因为他不重要。
t: Short not because he's unimportant.

zh: 短是因为他烧得快。
t: Short because he burns fast.

zh: 把这句「可以」记下来。
t: Write down this 'all right.'

zh: 「可以。这样很好。」
t: "All right. This is good."

zh: 记下了。这一句将来要还给她。
t: Noted. This line must be returned to her, in time.

zh: 把「算得出结局，改不了结局」记下来。
t: Write down 'can calculate the ending, but cannot change it.'

zh: 她什么都算得到，唯独改不动。
t: She can calculate everything, and only that she cannot change.

zh: 记下了。这也正是她要你替她改的原因。
t: Noted. And that is exactly why she needs you to change it for her.

zh: 什么都不说，把水面那一圈看完。
t: Say nothing; watch the ring on the water's surface fade.

zh: 零看着那圈涟漪散完，才转身。
t: Zero watched the ripple fade completely before turning.

zh: 放过去了。她不会怪你——她算到了你会放过去。
t: Let it pass. She won't blame you—she calculated that you would let it pass.

zh: 水退了。退得干干净净，像从没来过。
t: The water receded. Receded clean away, as if it had never come.

zh: 前面那一片是红的。红得有声音。
t: The stretch ahead was red. So red it had a sound.

zh: 检测到高温。检测到音频。音量：极高。
t: High temperature detected. Audio detected. Volume: extreme.

zh: （来了。下一位是全篇最短的一段，也是全篇最响的一段。）
t: (Here it comes. The next one is the shortest passage in the whole work, and the loudest.)

zh: 卷七
t: Volume Seven

zh: 火之领地
t: The Territory of Fire

zh: 最短的一段
t: The Shortest Passage

zh: 激燃的音乐，大片级的特效，存在感强到过分。
t: Blazing music, blockbuster-grade effects, a presence so strong it's excessive.

zh: 第五块领地是红的。
t: The fifth territory is red.

zh: 一脚踏进来，音乐就砸下来了。砸得胸口发麻。
t: The moment you step in, the music comes crashing down. Crashing until your chest goes numb.

zh: 天上、地上、四面八方，全是大片级的特效。一层压一层，压得人喘不上气。
t: Sky, ground, all directions—everywhere blockbuster-grade effects. Layer upon layer, pressing until you can't breathe.

zh: 欢迎欢迎！！！最强热的领地！！！
t: Welcome welcome!!! The territory of ultimate heat!!!

zh: 听到这BGM了吗！看到这特效了吗！震撼吧！
t: Hear this BGM?! See these effects?! Aren't they stunning?!

zh: ……震撼。
t: …Stunning.

zh: 大声点！
t: Louder!

zh: 震撼！！
t: Stunning!!

zh: 这就对了！
t: That's more like it!

zh: 整片领地在烧。烧成一座城市的样子——楼是火，街是火，连影子都是亮的。
t: The whole territory was burning. Burning into the shape of a city—buildings of fire, streets of fire, even the shadows aglow.

zh: 零走了不到一刻钟，就走到了头。
t: Zero walked less than a quarter-hour before reaching the end.

zh: （对，就这么长。）
t: (Yes, just that long.)

zh: （别的领地要走上大半天，他这一片一刻钟就走完了。）
t: (Other territories take half a day to walk; his is done in a quarter-hour.)

zh: （短不是因为他不重要。短是因为他烧得快。）
t: (Short not because he's unimportant. Short because he burns fast.)

zh: 我这本账，记强度。
t: My ledger records intensity.

zh: 就记一样：此刻最亮的那一下。
t: Only one thing: the brightest flare of this moment.

zh: 谁今天最亮，谁今天就存在得最足。
t: Whoever burns brightest today exists most fully today.

zh: 那昨天呢？
t: And yesterday?

zh: 音乐停了半拍。
t: The music stopped half a beat.

zh: ……昨天？
t: …Yesterday?

zh: 昨天已经不亮了啊。
t: Yesterday is no longer bright.

zh: 不亮了的，就不算存在过？
t: What's no longer bright, then it didn't exist?

zh: 火烧得更旺了。旺到零得眯起眼睛。
t: The fire burned fiercer. So fierce Zero had to squint.

zh: 你问这个干嘛。
t: Why ask that.

zh: 我在替青梧问。
t: I'm asking for Qingwu.

zh: 火一下子矮了半截。
t: The fire shrank by half all at once.

zh: 他跟你说的。
t: He told you.

zh: 他没来得及说完。他留了三件事，第三件没想出来。
t: He didn't get to finish. He left three things; the third he never thought of.

zh: ……那件我知道。
t: …I know that one.

zh: 告诉我。
t: Tell me.

zh: 不。
t: No.

zh: 那件得他自己说。
t: That one he must say himself.

zh: 零，我问你个事。
t: Zero, let me ask you something.

zh: 人们感受到我的震撼。这个我办到了，办得很漂亮。
t: People felt my awe. That I accomplished, and accomplished beautifully.

zh: 可是——震撼过后，剩下什么？
t: But—after the awe, what remains?

zh: ……剩下什么？
t: …What remains?

zh: 我不知道。
t: I don't know.

zh: 我每天都在烧。烧得越旺，就越看不清自己。
t: I burn every day. The fiercer I burn, the less I can see myself.

zh: 我是火。
t: I am Fire.

zh: 火照不亮自己的里面。
t: Fire cannot light up its own inside.

zh: 他站在火的正中间，被自己烧出来的光围得严严实实。
t: He stood at the very center of the fire, wrapped tight in the light of his own burning.

zh: 那圈光很亮。亮到里面什么都看不见。
t: That ring of light was bright. So bright you could see nothing within.

zh: 如果有一天我烧过头了……
t: If one day I burn too far…

zh: 这片残像，会不会跟着我一起——
t: would this Afterimage follow me and—

zh: 后半句没能说完。
t: The second half went unspoken.

zh: 音乐在这一拍上停了。停得极其干脆。
t: The music stopped on that beat. Stopped with utter finality.

zh: 接上他那半句：不会。
t: Pick up his half-line: no.

zh: 不会。
t: No.

zh: 它不会跟着你一起没掉。我会把它记下来。
t: It won't vanish with you. I'll record it.

zh: 那你记着。
t: Then keep it recorded.

zh: （他这句「那你记着」，是在托付。）
t: (This line of his, 'then keep it recorded,' is an entrusting.)

zh: 问他：你想让谁看见你里面？
t: Ask him: whom do you want to see your inside?

zh: 你想让谁看见你的里面？
t: Whom do you want to see your inside?

zh: 火静了很久。久到音乐重新起了一个很轻的前奏。
t: The fire was silent a long while. So long the music began again, with a very soft prelude.

zh: ……有个家伙。
t: …There's a guy.

zh: 他答应过我，谁先撑不住，就由对方把自己熄灭。
t: He promised me: whoever falters first, the other will extinguish them.

zh: （伏笔，已埋：木与火的旧约。）
t: (Foreshadowing, planted: the old pact of Wood and Fire.)

zh: 什么都不问，让他烧完。
t: Ask nothing; let him burn out.

zh: 零站在火里，等他烧完这一轮。
t: Zero stood in the fire, waiting for him to burn out this cycle.

zh: 烧完了。火矮下去，矮成一小簇。
t: Burned out. The fire sank low, into a small cluster.

zh: ……走吧。
t: …Go.

zh: 零走出火之领地的时候，背后那座火城正在一层一层地塌。
t: As Zero walked out of the territory of Fire, the city of fire behind was collapsing, layer by layer.

zh: 塌得很安静。安静得跟刚才那阵巨响不像同一次。
t: It collapsed very quietly. So quietly it seemed a different event from the roar just now.

zh: （记着这一刻。）
t: (Remember this moment.)

zh: （下一卷开始，就不只是这一块地的事了。）
t: (From the next volume on, it's no longer only about this one patch of land.)

zh: 全线温度：异常。
t: System-wide temperature: abnormal.

zh: 下篇
t: Part Three

zh: 罢工
t: The Strike

zh: THE STRIKE
t: THE STRIKE

zh: 五个灵魂同时停笔。停笔之后，世界由谁来记？
t: Five souls lay down their pens at once. Once they do, who will record the world?

zh: 卷八
t: Volume Eight

zh: 危机
t: The Crisis

zh: 记账者罢工
t: The Accountants' Strike

zh: 紫、蓝、绿。彼此平等。
t: Purple, blue, green. Equal to one another.

zh: 零走出火之领地，回头看了一眼。
t: Zero walked out of the territory of Fire and looked back once.

zh: 回头这一眼，看见的是五块领地同时亮了一下。
t: That backward glance saw the five territories all flash at once.

zh: 亮过之后，五个方向一起灭了。
t: After the flash, all five directions went dark together.

zh: 五处账本：停止写入。
t: Five ledgers: writing suspended.

zh: 五处账本：停止写入。停止原因：记账人撤回。
t: Five ledgers: writing suspended. Reason: accountants withdrawn.

zh: （出事了。）
t: (Something's wrong.)

zh: （火那半句话，问出来的不是疑问，是把整件事掀了。）
t: (Fire's half-line wasn't a question—it overturned everything.)

zh: （他问的是：我烧完了以后，我是谁。）
t: (What he asked was: once I've burned out, who am I.)

zh: （这个问题一旦被问出口，五本账同时就记不下去了。）
t: (Once that question is asked aloud, all five ledgers stop being writable at once.)

zh: 木之领地的草停止了生长。停得极其突兀——像有人按了暂停。
t: The grass of the territory of Wood stopped growing. Stopped so abruptly—as if someone had hit pause.
